name: kashzod
description: KashZod's plugin catalog. Hosts devloop, a spec-plan-implement TDD loop with independent review-agent gates.

plugins.name: devloop
plugins.description: Spec, plan, implement, review: a test-driven development loop for AI coding agents. Three commands map to three gates, one per command: /spec (WHAT), /plan (HOW), /implement (BUILD), with independent review agents (review-plan, review-impl, red-team) as hard gates.
